name: skinny_gemm_tn
description: Bias-free linear projection at decode-time skinny M: C[M,N] = A[M,K] @ B[N,K]^T (nn.Linear TN weight layout). This is the per-token projection workhorse of hybrid LLM decode (Qwen3.8-27B: every Gated DeltaNet in/out projection, every attention Q/K/V/O projection, every SwiGLU gate/up/down projection, and the LM head). At M=1..32 it is GEMV-like and purely weight-bandwidth-bound; the incumbent cuBLAS answer is a narrow-tile split-K kernel plus a separate reduce. The optimization target is to beat cuBLAS on Blackwell (sm100/sm103/sm120) with a cuTile kernel, e.g. via split-K over K with fp32 accumulation followed by a deterministic reduction, L2-aware N-swizzling, and wide TMA vectorized B loads.

M.description: Token/row count. Decode is M=1; MTP/speculative or small-chunk prefill uses small M (<= 32).

b.description: Projection weight in nn.Linear layout (out_features=N, in_features=K), row-major contiguous; the op computes a @ b.T without materializing the transpose.
